text:
George had $5.00 originally, and with 1% of his money left, he had:
$5.00 \times 0.01 = \$0.05$ left.

The total amount he spent was:
$\$5.00 - \$0.05 = \$4.95$ (or 495 cents).

He bought 3 bags of chips:
$3 \times 40\text{ cents} = 120\text{ cents}$.

The money spent on candy bars was:
$495\text{ cents} - 120\text{ cents} = 375\text{ cents}$.

Since candy bars cost 75 cents each, the number of candy bars he bought is:
$375 / 75 = 5$.

ANSWER: 5
